_note: Named hotels and hotel cards for in-text affiliate links (lib/aff-inline.ts). Articles reference these by key: [name](aff:hotel/<key>), [text](aff:near/<key>), and a line [x](aff:pick/<key>) for a card. Booking.com on/off + CJ link live in affiliates.json. Every hotel carries the date it was last checked open and listed (`verified`); re-check before Expo 2027 (see BELGRADEBEST_AFFILIATE_STRATEGY.md). Disclosure (2026-11-16, after the Codex review): every commercial block opens with an "Ad" label (adLabel) and a one-line commission note (cardNote) BEFORE its links; every in-text affiliate link is followed by a small "Ad" tag; the date line explains the label (pageDisclosure).
